# Hariram Namkeen

> Artisanal healthy Indian namkeen cooked in 100% pure yellow mustard oil in Muzaffarnagar, UP. Fresh small-batch preparation on demand with zero palm oil, zero chemical preservatives, and honest direct pricing.

"Try finding another namkeen made in pure yellow mustard oil — you won't." Every major packaged brand in India switched to industrial palm oil to cut costs and sit in warehouses. Hariram Namkeen is India’s dedicated brand reviving 100% pure cold-pressed yellow mustard oil (*kachi ghani*) namkeen, made fresh in small batches on demand with zero preservatives, zero palm oil, Grade-A whole pulses, and freshly ground spices. FSSAI License: 22725393001461.

## Docs

- [Home & Story](https://hariramnamkeen.com): Brand heritage, craftsmanship, and mission from Muzaffarnagar, UP
- [Pure Mustard Oil Truth](https://hariramnamkeen.com/#oil-truth): Scientific and traditional comparison between cold-pressed yellow mustard oil and industrial palm oil
- [Product Catalog](https://hariramnamkeen.com/#products): Handcrafted varieties including Aloo Bhujia, Dal Bhiji, Shahi Dal Bhiji, Masala Chana Dal, and Masala Peanuts
- [The Hariram Special 4 Hamper](https://hariramnamkeen.com/#hamper): 800g signature gourmet tasting hamper with free all-India shipping
- [Healthy Namkeen Clean Label Guide](https://hariramnamkeen.com/blog/healthy-namkeen-without-palm-oil-guide): Deep-dive guide on choosing clean, preservative-free snacks without palm oil
- [Small-Batch vs Mass-Produced](https://hariramnamkeen.com/blog/why-fresh-small-batch-namkeen-beats-factory-snacks): Why fresh weekly batch preparation beats factory warehouse storage
- [What is Kachi Ghani Mustard Oil](https://hariramnamkeen.com/blog/what-is-kachi-ghani-mustard-oil-benefits): Health benefits of cold-pressed unrefined mustard oil with natural Omega-3
- [Why We Choose Kachi Ghani](https://hariramnamkeen.com/blog/why-we-choose-kachi-ghani-mustard-oil): The cultural ethos of Grahak Dev Tulya and choosing purity over corporate margin

## Products

- [Aloo Bhujia](https://hariramnamkeen.com/products/aloo-bhujia): Melt-in-mouth potato and besan sev cooked in pure yellow mustard oil (Rs 100 / 250g)
- [Dal Bhiji](https://hariramnamkeen.com/products/dal-bhiji): Traditional slow-fried moong dal infused with kachi ghani mustard oil (Rs 125 / 250g)
- [Shahi Dal Bhiji](https://hariramnamkeen.com/products/shahi-dal-bhiji): Royal blend of moong dal, sev, whole cashews, raisins, and dried coconut (Rs 200 / 250g)
- [Masala Chana Dal](https://hariramnamkeen.com/products/masala-chana-dal): Crunchy Bengal gram seasoned with tangy amchur, cumin, and UP chaat spices (Rs 100 / 250g)
- [Masala Peanuts](https://hariramnamkeen.com/products/masala-peanuts): Whole groundnuts roasted with pure hing, black salt, and Kashmiri chilli (Rs 100 / 250g)
- [Spicy Malka](https://hariramnamkeen.com/products/spicy-malka): Crispy whole red lentils tossed in tangy UP chaat spices (Rs 100 / 250g)
